title.en: The company that kept the page blank

caption.en: One input box, nothing else. Everyone else filled the page.
caption.ko: 칸 하나, 그게 전부였다. 나머지는 다 채웠다.

moral.en: Leaving it blank wasn't laziness. It was the hardest choice.
moral.ko: 비워두는 건 게을러서가 아니었다. 가장 어려운 선택이었다.

cta.en: Next time I'll watch another company from a distance.
cta.ko: 다음엔 또 다른 회사를 멀리서 본다.

narration.en: The internet was loud. Their page was almost empty.
narration.ko: 인터넷은 시끄러웠다. 그 페이지는 비어 있었다.

image_hint.en: dim office with an old monitor showing an empty white page, one person far away, seen from behind, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: dim office with an old monitor showing an empty white page, one person far away, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: Other sites stacked links. Banners, lists, noise. I thought the blank one was broken.
narration.ko: 다른 사이트는 링크를 쌓았다. 배너도, 목록도, 잡동사니도. 나는 그 빈 화면이 고장인 줄 알았다.

image_hint.en: cluttered desk with a busy web portal on screen, one person leaning back in the dark, distant figure

scenes.image_prompt: cluttered desk with a busy web portal on screen, one person leaning back in the dark, distant figure

narration.en: I typed one word. The answer came in half a second. That was all it did.
narration.ko: 단어를 하나 넣었다. 답이 반 초 만에 나왔다. 그게 전부였다.

image_hint.en: small dorm room at night, one person typing at a desk, seen from behind, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: small dorm room at night, one person typing at a desk, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: Years passed. A small line appeared beside the answer. It was an ad. It didn't look like one.
narration.ko: 몇 년이 지났다. 답 옆에 작은 줄이 붙었다. 광고였다. 티가 안 났다.

image_hint.en: office corridor with server racks, one person walking away, distant figure, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: office corridor with server racks, one person walking away, distant figure, long shot

narration.en: Maps and video started the same way. Empty first. Then one thing.
narration.ko: 지도도 영상도 같은 방식이었다. 먼저 비우고, 하나만 남겼다.

image_hint.en: warehouse of stacked cardboard boxes, one person standing in the middle distance, seen from behind

scenes.image_prompt: warehouse of stacked cardboard boxes, one person standing in the middle distance, seen from behind

narration.en: Everyone was scared of empty space. They kept it.
narration.ko: 다들 빈 공간이 무서웠다. 저쪽은 그걸 남겨뒀다.

image_hint.en: library aisle with mostly empty shelves, one person standing still, seen from behind

scenes.image_prompt: library aisle with mostly empty shelves, one person standing still, seen from behind

subtitle.en: The money was beside the answer.

narration.en: The money wasn't the answer. It was that one line next to it.
narration.ko: 돈이 된 건 답이 아니었다. 답 옆의 그 한 줄이었다.

image_hint.en: conference room at dusk with an empty table, one person by the window, back to the camera

scenes.image_prompt: conference room at dusk with an empty table, one person by the window, back to the camera

narration.en: Now it's worth over three trillion. And the first screen is still blank.
narration.ko: 지금 값은 3조 달러가 넘는다. 그리고 첫 화면은 아직 비어 있다.

image_hint.en: city skyline at dawn seen from a rooftop, one small figure at the railing, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: city skyline at dawn seen from a rooftop, one small figure at the railing, long shot

narration.en: This morning I pressed that box again. Still white.
narration.ko: 오늘 아침, 그 칸을 다시 눌렀다. 여전히 하얬다.
